# Sea View Serenity

> Seaside holiday house near Delfini Beach, Syros (Cyclades, Greece). Three bedrooms, sea views, full kitchen, parking. Ideal for families and friends.

- Site: https://seaviewserenity.gr/
- Brand: Sea View Serenity
- Location: Delfini Beach, Ano Syros 81400, Syros, Greece
- Coordinates: 37.4584631, 24.9024781
- Phone / WhatsApp: +30 693 702 7555
